facts.fact: An interviewed digital transformation expert (Fatih Kezim) says the sectors' platforms in finance, higher education, interior and justice mostly run separately, with no automatic data exchange between them; as_of is the document's published date.
facts.system: National data exchange between sector platforms

facts.fact: The expert lists, among official figures, the launch of a secure data exchange platform and the national digital services portal, giving no description of bodies connected; as_of is the document's published date.
facts.system: Secure data exchange platform (منصة التبادل الآمن للبيانات)
